preconditions.description: The length of the string t is between 1 and 10^4.

postconditions.description: The length of the restored string s is equal to the length of t.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
postconditions.description: Each character in the restored string s is a lowercase Latin letter.
